The stretch of this highway that runs along the south side of Burr Oak State Park in Morgan County, Ohio, is well known for its extreme curves and views, and is sometimes locally referred to as the "Rim of the World."  Much of this highway runs through old coal-producing areas.»
[2] «Ohio State Route 141 | State Route 141 (SR 141) is an east–west highway crossing through southeast Ohio, though it predominantly runs more north–south. Symmes Valley High School and Symmes Valley Elementary School are also located along State Route 141, just to the east of Aid. A portion of A1A that passes through Volusia County is designated the Ormond Scenic Loop and Trail, a Florida Scenic Highway.
